 Morgan Rogers reveals who he thinks is Chelsea’s fastest player – the numbers don’t lie 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Xabi Alonso has often set out for Chelsea to play on the counter, and that is because he wants to utilise his side’s pace when the opponents are attacking. But which player is the quickest? 
 Chelsea boast huge pace going forward. Joao Pedro, Morgan Rogers and Cole Palmer are very quick with and without the ball, while Estevao, Pedro Neto , and Geovany Quenda are all quick from Chelsea’s flanks.
 OneFootball Videos
 Even at wing-back, Pep Chavarria and Josh Acheampong are not slow at all, while Jorrel Hato showed his speed against Brighton. This is a very quick Chelsea team, but Rogers knows who the quickest is of all.
 Morgan Rogers picks Chelsea’s quickest player, and he’s right
 Right up there at the top of the list are players like Estevao, Neto, Rogers, Pedro, and Palmer. But who does England star Rogers think is Chelsea’s quickest player? He did a quick-fire round on Viaplay’s TikTok .
 He named Jordan Henderson as the funniest, and the player he’d call in an emergency. Cole Palmer was named the player with the highest footballing IQ, while Rogers named Neto as Chelsea’s fastest player.
 TalkingPoints
 Pedro Neto has been hailed as an 'unsung hero' for Chelsea. Who else in Xabi Alonso's team is UNDERRATED?!
 If the stats can be used as a literal barometer to prove Rogers right or wrong, then he is correct. Neto is the fastest player in Chelsea’s squad, recording the fastest speed in the Premier League against Brighton.
 During the 4-3 win over the Seagulls, in which Neto scored one of his three Premier League goals this term, Neto recorded 35.26 km/h. Jorrel Hato is currently second with 34.8 km/h; Acheampong is third.
 Who has recorded Chelsea’s quickest-ever Premier League speed?
 It might surprise you that Neto is Chelsea’s fastest player. But the fastest recorded speed of any Chelsea player in the Premier League – with speeds recorded by Opta from 20-21 onwards – is Antonio Rudiger.
 The big German centre-back, who has been linked with a return to Chelsea in January from Real Madrid, clocked up a whopping 36.72 km/h. A full 1.5 km/h more than Neto’s effort in the win against Brighton.
 Chelsea’s second-fastest Premier League player remains on the Blues’ books, but is currently out on loan at Tottenham. Mykhailo Mudryk was close to Rudiger’s record, running at 36.62 km/h against Liverpool.
 Neto can go quicker and has done. But the Portugal international has been excellent for Chelsea this season, amid doubts that he would remain in the summer. This, simply, is more proof he must be kept.
